title: Python and Qt Tool Development for 3ds Max
purpose: Develop organized Python tools for 3ds Max with a MaxScript launcher, safe restart, editable themes, reusable Qt components, layered testing, and official MaxPkg MZP delivery.

steps: Import this standalone community/custom skill ZIP in a compatible Max Ultra MCP build, then start a new AI chat. It is separate from the product's built-in skills; importing it does not install or run a Python tool.

Ask for Python and Qt Tool Development for 3ds Max. Supply the tool's purpose or existing code, target Max releases, intended scene effects, and project destination. Specify your preference for responsive breakpoint adaptation; the assistant must ask before enabling it if no choice was supplied.

Request a thin .ms launcher, a restart-safe Python lifecycle, separated modules/resources/docs, and the shared Qt design system. Theme selection starts with Warm Graphite and uses the included editable palette references. Button icons use original Lucide Icons unless you request a different set.

For real-Max verification, provide an authorized isolated or synthetic Max fixture connected through Max Ultra MCP. Request smoke, unit, regression, interface and visual checks across each available supported Python/Qt family. Unavailable hosts and unrun scenarios must remain explicitly untested.

Creating a tool includes a package-ready source project and a local installable MZP built by the official MaxPkg Packager through its API in a selected Max instance. Supply any missing legal/identity facts. Build and archive checks are separate from authorized install/update/uninstall tests; report unavailable tooling or hosts as blockers. Narrow edits/audits stay scoped; external publication and push require separate authorization.
examples: Use Python and Qt Tool Development for 3ds Max to build a scene report tool for Max 2022 and 2025. Use a .ms launcher and clean restart, theme selection in Settings, Warm Graphite by default, and stable typography without breakpoint scaling. Do not modify scene objects. Deliver the source project and an MZP built with the official MaxPkg Packager; report any missing prerequisites.

Refactor this Python Qt tool so rerunning its MaxScript launcher disposes of previous windows, timers and callbacks. Add cancellation and block replacement if an owned worker cannot stop. Preserve unrelated Max state.

Apply the shared Qt design system to this tool: editable palettes, rounded fields and dropdowns, Lucide icons, consistent tabs, Settings veils and copy feedback. Ask me about responsive adaptation before implementing breakpoints.

Design isolated tests for this tool's theme switching, repeated launch, HTML resize reentrancy, context menus, spin controls and 200%+ DPI rendering. Use available disposable Max instances through MCP and report exact tested runtimes and missing coverage.
usage.expectedOutput: For tool creation: a maintainable source project with a .ms entry point, safe restart, reusable themed Qt components, documentation, layered test evidence, and a locally built official MaxPkg MZP with archive verification; if blocked, the fullest verified ready-to-build project and explicit missing prerequisites. Narrow refactors/audits stay scoped. Includes practical references and seven verified palettes. Recipes are adaptable examples, not a drop-in library or pixel-identical guarantee; no practical Max testing of this skill is claimed.

dependencies: A coding-capable AI client and filesystem access to the tool project; the reference product checkout is not required after importing this skill.

For generated tools: Autodesk 3ds Max with its bundled Python, pymxs, qtmax and matching PySide/Qt family. Inspect actual target versions and capabilities; no exact Max release has been practically tested for this skill.
For host verification: Max Ultra MCP connected to an authorized isolated/synthetic Max instance. Pure logic and standalone Qt tests use separate suitable development environments.

For default local MZP delivery: current official maxpkg-dev/max-dev-tool guidance and original packager/hooks, required project metadata and icon/licenses, and a selected suitable 3ds Max connection exposing MaxPkgPackerApi through Max Ultra MCP. No custom ZIP-to-MZP substitute is permitted.
Generated tool button icons require original Lucide SVG assets and their license unless the user requests another icon set. Icons are not bundled in this instruction-only skill.
A Max Ultra MCP custom-skill importer supporting the optional skill.json display manifest. This package contains instructions and JSON palette references, not executable helpers.
